Foster Coldstores offers full UK coverage, delivering directly from our manufacturing plant using our dedicated transport partners. As the market leading British manufacturer of coldrooms, we pride ourselves on delivering you the highest standards in product quality and customer service. Coldroom production has been operating out of our factory in King’s Lynn, Norfolk since 1968! We supply refrigeration equipment to a variety of markets including: Restaurants, Hotels, Sporting venues, Hospitals, Government run facilities and many more. We’re confident we have the right product for your business, and you can be confident you are investing in reliable, energy efficient and resilient equipment which will provide you with unrivalled performance for many years. We have gained accreditations by industry bodies and accolades from our community including the Mayors Business Awards and other industry awards and recognition.
